bootstrap: Explicit human instruction to current sole Root to publish initial protocol; absent lease makes subsequent hosted workers read-only, not an implicit acquisition.
next_action: Read A2 non-author exact review; recheck lease epoch/head and queue, dispatch corrected resource-only probe once. Preserve A1 failure. Then prepare exact17 dependencies and all50 schema generator diagnosis.

protocol.reads: Read exact canonical ref, then lease at that immutable head before decisions. Missing, malformed or unreadable lease: read-only/preparation, no canonical writes and no jobs.
protocol.acquire: Only released or conclusively UTC-expired lease AND no queued/in_progress project runs permits successor. Choose unique owner/run/epoch, acquired/expires <=45min. Create administrative commit from exact latest head and update_ref expected_sha/force=false. CAS failure: reread original ref+lease, never force or assume ownership.
protocol.renew: Current matching owner/run/epoch only, before expiry, every real checkpoint and no later than15min. CAS from current head. expires <=45min from renewal. Never renew after losing epoch or expiration; successor rules apply.
protocol.pre_mutation: Before Source adoption, new execution branch, project job or canonical mutation, re-read exact head and held/unexpired owner/run/epoch. Only this owner serially schedules resources; if mismatch, stop.
protocol.release: Before ending bounded round, CAS state released with released_at and expires_at equal UTC now, active jobs accurately recorded and clear next_action. Do not release while concealing queued/running work.
protocol.resource: source-recovery-bytes/cancel-in-progress=false, single project job; aggregate512MiB/swap0/DATA64MiB, only previously authorized named exceptions.
protocol.unreadable_or_conflict: Stop mutations/execution. Do not change identity, bypass network, use Windows/localhost, force refs or lower gates.
